author: SickProdigy
description: Connect each Discord server to its own shared Google Calendar.
end_user_data_statement: Google stores calendar events. This cog stores per-server calendar settings and minimal Discord user IDs associated with events created through the bot.
install_msg: The bot owner must configure a Google Calendar service account. Then use [p]calendarset serviceaccount and [p]calendarset calendar.
name: CalendarEvents
short: Manage a server-owned Google Calendar from Discord.
